messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Your order's on track. It's paid, and your Harlo B30 is a batch 4 unit that ships November 14.

The Power K. is already set aside at our Tennessee warehouse and goes in the same box. The B30 is the only thing it's waiting on, and the US batch of B30s is arriving at that warehouse now. You can follow that batch's progress on our shipment status page: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

As soon as it leaves the warehouse, we'll email the tracking to the address on your order.
